name: UserElements Member Export for Ultimate Member
author: UserElements

sections.description:
UserElements Member Export for Ultimate Member is the most efficient way to extract and download your user data. Whether you are migrating sites, building mailing lists, or backing up member profiles, this plugin gives you complete control over your Ultimate Member data exports.

Built specifically for Ultimate Member, our plugin features a powerful Field Mapper that allows you to choose exactly which user meta fields to include in your export.

Key Features:

  • CSV Export: Instantly generate and download your Ultimate Member user data in a clean CSV format.
  • Visual Field Mapping: Use our drag-and-drop interface to sort, select, and organize the exact fields you want to export.
  • Seamless Integration: Built natively for the Ultimate Member ecosystem.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Optimized for performance so your site remains fast, even when exporting large user directories.

Why use UserElements Member Export?
Default export tools often pull messy, unorganized data. UserElements Member Export allows you to map your fields precisely, saving you hours of formatting in Excel or Google Sheets.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the userelements-member-export-for-ultimate-member folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the new Export settings page in your WordPress admin dashboard to start mapping your fields.
sections.faq:
Do I need the Ultimate Member plugin installed?

Yes, this is an add-on built specifically to export data generated by the Ultimate Member plugin.

Can I choose which fields are exported?

Absolutely. The plugin includes a drag-and-drop Field Mapper so you can include or exclude specific user meta fields.

What format is the export file?

The data is exported as a standard CSV (.csv) file, which can be opened in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or Apple Numbers.
